device.modelDescription: A module that calls compose-crasher, which fails after the runtime refused its own call, and then throws.

actionList.name: relayThrow
actionList.description: Calls compose-crasher, then throws an untyped error of its own.

actionList.name: relayRethrow
actionList.description: Calls compose-rethrower, then throws an untyped error of its own.

actionList.name: relayBig
actionList.description: Calls compose-big, then throws an untyped error of its own.

actionList.name: relaySlowTask
actionList.description: As a task: calls compose-slowbad (its hop times out), then compose-callee (it goes through), waits past the first one's late answer, then throws.
